title: Avila Core Requirement Set v0.1 draft
description: A library's owned list of what any contract in its domain must address. A case declares which of its contract requirements cover each entry and states, with an accepting owner, why any entry is omitted. Coverage is a report about the contract, not a verdict about a design.

kind.description: The quantity kind a covering contract requirement must compare.

minimum_basis.description: The weakest basis on which a covering requirement may be evaluated; nominal < bounded < enclosure.

omission.description: must_state: leaving the entry uncovered requires a stated reason and an accepting owner. may_omit: silent omission is permitted.
